::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 27th [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 17
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

Besides what I sent on Monday and the 63 pp I am sending by this days post, there are 380 pp of [the Trial](cmy_books/cmybook_53.qmd) in type in the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd), and in MS what I should think would make about 45 or 50 more.

I am writing to [Mrs Blackburn](people/person_159.qmd) about her drawings

Yours faithfully
C. M. Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
